title: Fix macOS Glitches
description: Restarts system UI processes and iPhone sync processes to fix common macOS glitches (frozen Dock, broken menu bar, stuck sync, etc.).

versions.notes: Shell commands run in the background, so the script stays responsive.
Error handling checks error numbers instead of messages, so it works in every system language.
Stopped processes restart through launchctl, and Finder restarts after iPhone sync processes so it sees connected devices.
Command-line mode and a test script for automated checks, and apps that depend on the menu bar reopen after it restarts.
Renamed to "Fix macOS Glitches", with a choice between iPhone sync processes and macOS interface processes such as the Dock and Control Center.
Plain-text script that lists which processes it restarted.
First version, published as a compiled script with its source text. Restarts the processes behind stuck iPhone syncing.
